Marcus — thanks for the recap and MAP. Quick answers from procurement/legal side:

1) Commercial path: Enterprise deals at ACME usually go direct via PO. Marketplace is sometimes used for one-off SaaS but procurement prefers direct contract for reserved capacity/discounts. Card is only for small purchases.

2) Typical timeline (approx):
- Legal review: 10–14 business days (can be longer if there are redlines)
- Security questionnaire (we’ll send our standard SIG/SDR): 5–7 business days from receipt
- Finance (PO issuance): 5–10 business days after approvals; real-world total from signature to PO in our experience ~3–5 weeks

3) I attached our SOW template (AcmeCloud_SOW_template.docx). Please use that as a reference for PO line items and billing contact.

We’re targeting a vendor decision by end of March and prefer to have the contract ready for PO issuance by mid-April if possible. We can tighten if legal moves faster.

I’ll have Tom coordinate QA/security with your SE.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of Procurement | ACME Cloud
priya@acmecloud.com | +1 (212) 555-0143
